name: Solvi: Elemental World
storyline:
At the beginning, there was only a small island surrounded by an endless sea. The elements existed, but the world was quiet, waiting to be discovered.

Through the simple combination of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, something extraordinary begins to happen. New elements emerge, life takes root, plants begin to grow, and the island slowly transforms into a living world.

As discoveries unfold, the environment changes. Weather shifts, seasons pass, wildlife finds its home, and eventually, people arrive to build a settlement of their own.

But this is only the beginning.

Across the world, new islands hold their own secrets, ecosystems, and discoveries waiting to be uncovered. From frozen coastlines to lush mangrove channels and mysterious ocean depths, every island has a story shaped by the elements.

There is no race against time and no single way to shape the world. Every discovery brings something new, and every player creates a journey of their own.

**A world waiting to grow. A story waiting to be discovered.**
